meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会逐个完整读取代码库里的每一个源文件,不论数量多少;大文件用 Read 工具的 offset 和 limit 分块翻页读完,以此建立对代码库的理解。
howto.when: 在开始接触新项目或不熟悉的项目时触发,或当你要求「learn the codebase」「read the codebase」「prime」等时接管。

say.text: 帮我学一下这个代码库,把所有源码读一遍
say.note: Claude 会逐个读完所有源文件

say.text: 读一下这个新项目的代码库
say.note: 针对新项目完整读源码

say.text: 让我快速上手这个不熟悉的项目
say.note: 先通读代码再开始做事

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads every source file in full, no matter how many there are, and pages through large files in chunks using the Read tool's offset and limit parameters to build an understanding of the codebase.
howto.when_en: Triggers when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", etc.

say_en.text: Learn this codebase — read every source file in full.
say_en.note: Claude reads all source files one by one.

say_en.text: Read the codebase for this new project.
say_en.note: Full source reading for the new project.

say_en.text: Help me get up to speed on this unfamiliar project.
say_en.note: Reads the code first, then works.
